About the school

The school was founded in Sharjah in 1991 and is accredited by the Council of International Schools. It operates in three sections: Primary (KG1 to Grade 4), and separate Boys' and Girls' Secondary Schools (Grade 5 to Grade 13).

Curriculum

KG1 to KG2 follow an approach combining the Early Years Foundation Stage, the British National Curriculum and the start of the Cambridge Primary Programme.

Grades 1 to 6 follow the Cambridge Primary Programme.

Grades 9 to 13 follow CIE syllabuses for Cambridge IGCSE, AS and A Level.

Vision

To be the UAE's premier school of choice, by inspiring our students to reach their potential, academically, socially, physically and morally
